summary: End-to-end testing of sabewell complaint tracker. 15/15 backend pytest assertions passed (auth, complaints CRUD, status updates, public track, masked phone, stats, auth guard). Frontend flows verified: landing, login (success + wrong password error), admin dashboard (stats + filter + search), new complaint form (CMP-2026-0003 created and navigated to /admin/c/{cid}), complaint detail page (timeline + status update form rendered). Twilio gracefully skipped (no 500 errors). All testids discovered and core functionality working.

issues: Date field uses native browser HTML5 date picker (input type='date') instead of shadcn Calendar component. Per code-review guidelines, shadcn calendar is preferred for consistent UX.

action_items: Optional: Replace native <input type='date'> on /admin/new with shadcn Calendar/Popover component for consistent UX.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~365 lines and well structured; consider splitting routes vs models if it grows.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} in all queries — good.
JWT_SECRET in .env should be rotated before production (currently default 'sabewell-super-secret-...').
send_whatsapp gracefully no-ops when Twilio creds blank — verified, no 500s.
PATCH /complaints/{cid}/status returns 400 on unchanged status (good defensive check).
test_credentials: admin@company.com / Admin@123 (seeded on startup, verified working)
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create complaints with TEST_ prefix (TEST_John Doe). Two UI complaints also created (TEST_UI Alpha = CMP-2026-0003).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Form data-testids on /admin/new use 'form-*' prefix (form-name-input, form-phone-input, form-address-input, form-serial-input, form-date-input, form-issue-input, form-submit-btn). Detail page uses 'status-select' (shadcn-style button, not native select), 'status-note-input', 'status-update-btn'. localStorage keys are 'sw_token' and 'sw_email'. Public /track/{cid} works without auth, returns phone_masked (asterisks + last 4).
